Fixes documentation build warns related to indentation, text formatting,
and missing reference on toc.

This fix solves the following warnings:

WARNING: Unexpected indentation.
WARNING: Block quote ends without a blank line; unexpected unindent.
WARNING: document isn't included in any toctree

Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

diff --git a/Documentation/misc-devices/index.rst b/Documentation/misc-devices/index.rst
index 64420b3314fe..30ac58f81901 100644
--- a/Documentation/misc-devices/index.rst
+++ b/Documentation/misc-devices/index.rst
@@ -19,6 +19,7 @@ fit into other categories.
    bh1770glc
    eeprom
    c2port
+   dw-xdata-pcie
    ibmvmc
    ics932s401
    isl29003
-- 
2.25.1



diff --git a/Documentation/misc-devices/dw-xdata-pcie.rst b/Documentation/misc-devices/dw-xdata-pcie.rst
index fd75c9321f47..cbc9f694d406 100644
--- a/Documentation/misc-devices/dw-xdata-pcie.rst
+++ b/Documentation/misc-devices/dw-xdata-pcie.rst
@@ -17,24 +17,24 @@ information to /var/log/kern.log or dmesg.
 
 Request write TLPs traffic generation - Root Complex to Endpoint direction
 - Command:
-	echo 1 > /sys/class/misc/dw-xdata-pcie/write
+echo 1 > /sys/class/misc/dw-xdata-pcie/write
 
 Get write TLPs traffic link throughput in MB/s
 - Command:
-        cat /sys/class/misc/dw-xdata-pcie/write
+cat /sys/class/misc/dw-xdata-pcie/write
 - Output example:
-	204
+204
 
 Request read TLPs traffic generation - Endpoint to Root Complex direction:
 - Command:
-	echo 1 > /sys/class/misc/dw-xdata-pcie/read
+echo 1 > /sys/class/misc/dw-xdata-pcie/read
 
 Get read TLPs traffic link throughput in MB/s
 - Command:
-        cat /sys/class/misc/dw-xdata-pcie/read
+cat /sys/class/misc/dw-xdata-pcie/read
 - Output example:
-	199
+199
 
 Request to stop any current TLP transfer:
 - Command:
-	echo 1 > /sys/class/misc/dw-xdata-pcie/stop
+echo 1 > /sys/class/misc/dw-xdata-pcie/stop

### Modifications in Each File

1. **`Documentation/misc-devices/index.rst`**
   - Added the entry `dw-xdata-pcie` to the list of devices. This inclusion helps in organizing the documentation and ensures that the `dw-xdata-pcie` driver is referenced correctly in the overall documentation structure.

2. **`Documentation/misc-devices/dw-xdata-pcie.rst`**
   - Corrected indentation issues and text formatting in the command examples. Specifically, the indentation for commands was adjusted to ensure consistent formatting, and unnecessary leading spaces were removed from the command lines and output examples. This change addresses warnings related to unexpected indentation and block quote formatting.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in `index.rst` and `dw-xdata-pcie.rst` are related in that they both contribute to improving the documentation for the `dw-xdata-pcie` driver. The addition of the driver to the index file ensures that it is included in the documentation's table of contents (toctree), which resolves the warning about the document not being included in any toctree. Meanwhile, the formatting corrections in the `dw-xdata-pcie.rst` file enhance the readability and presentation of the documentation, addressing various warnings about formatting issues. Together, these changes improve the overall quality and accessibility of the documentation for users.
